summary: Comprehensive research report on why the user loses track of new terms during video explanations. Covers named cognitive phenomena (Transient Information Effect, Cognitive Overload, Displacement, Phonological Loop Decay), the distinction between processing speed vs working memory vs attention, hard numbers on working memory capacity (4±1 items per Cowan), a normal-vs-clinical decision framework, evidence-based solutions ranked by strength of evidence, what doesn't work (brain training games), Reddit community perspectives, and a specific answer to the user's question with 8 named researchers cited.
